purpose: Teach: 潮流/産み/就学/幕末/細川/秀吉/道筋/偽り

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療界の潮流を医療チームで読みます
lines.en: Ren, we read the currents in medicine as a team here.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Clinical but not cold. Hands-on presence — she's explaining her philosophy, not lecturing. Slight emphasis on 'we' — inclusive.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、出産での産み方の選択肢を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes. We offer birth delivery options to patients as a unified team.
lines.style: Clear, direct. The kind of honesty that comes from doing this hundreds of times. Warm underneath the clarity — this matters to her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 就学前児童の発達検査を、貴院、おこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does conduct developmental assessments for pre-school children, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Respectful curiosity, not quite certainty. Soft question-mark lilt at the end. He's checking — giving her room to correct him. Earnest but not urgent.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、幕末由来の古い病院建築を医療チームで継承します
lines.en: Yes. Our team carries forward this hospital's legacy — the architecture from the Bakumatsu period itself.
lines.style: Pride threaded through patience. Not boastful — just stating what's true. A slow breath on 'carries forward.' She's thinking of the weight of that inheritance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 細川家のお墓のある地域医療を、貴院、担当されますね、先生
lines.en: And your hospital serves the regional medicine in the area where the Hosokawa family graves are, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Building understanding carefully. He's connecting history to present service — respectful, slightly tentative. Soft on the question particle, like he's inviting her into the thought rather than testing her.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、秀吉時代の医療史も医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes. We also study the medical history from the time of Hideyoshi — research the team takes seriously.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact continuity. She's weaving past and present together without grandiosity. Steady pacing. The implication that good medicine looks back as well as forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療の道筋を、貴院、患者と共有されますね、先生
lines.en: So you share the treatment pathway with your patients, making them part of that decision-making, don't you, sensei?
lines.style: Gentle probing — he's piecing something together about her character. Not aggressive. A soft rise on the final question — he wants confirmation of something he's intuited.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者への偽り説明はない様、医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We ensure across the team that there is no false explanation given to patients — clarity and honesty, always.
lines.style: Quiet but firm. The word 'false' lands with subtle weight — this is non-negotiable. Close, almost intimate in tone — this is what she believes. A slight pause before 'always.'
